tokenizer.packing_semantics: EOS is supervised; EOS separates documents but attention crosses documents. Model shifts within each L window: L-1 targets, boundary next-token targets are omitted by the existing pipeline.
tokenizer.special_supervision: PAD/BOS and chat role markers ignored; document EOS and assistant end_of_turn are legitimate targets.

memorization_results.interpretation: Training-set memorization and independent heldout performance are separate. Heldout uses one withheld prose template, not a representative generalization benchmark. Scratch 87m memorization never establishes real pretrained 87m capability.

candidate_summary.label: PROVISIONAL
candidate_summary.interpretation: Only ACCEPT contributes to formal counts. Pending items are exploratory. Wilson intervals describe item uncertainty, not benchmark representativeness. Separate and joint_shared_prefix must never be mixed or compared as a capability delta.

reproducibility.interpretation: Exact within this software/device. Independent run IDs, output paths and checkpoint serialization timestamps may differ.

experiment_87m.reason: Task requires CPU Nano execution and explicitly bounded opt-in for 87M; no 87M training was requested or started.

training_chain_findings: No new P0/P1 correctness fault observed. Existing loss/optimizer/scheduler/cursor/recovery semantics unchanged.
Existing packed L windows supervise L-1 targets and allow attention across EOS; documented, not altered.
